name: USGS Cal DIG I v2 offshore bathymetry and CMECS habitat

producer.name: U.S. Geological Survey and Bureau of Ocean Energy Management

units.bathymetry_elevation: m in original USGS source vertical reference

spatial.horizontal_crs: EPSG:26910 for the original bathymetry raster; EPSG:4269 geographic NAD83 for CMECS polygons

temporal.update_cadence: Static version 2 release; monthly catalog and exact-archive integrity audit.

provenance.access_service: USGS Coastal and Marine Geoscience Data System original DOI release
transformations: Scanned every valid cell of the exact bathymetry GeoTIFF at native 10 m resolution and counted depth-threshold candidates; counted CMECS polygon attributes from the exact source shapefile without generating a fishing target.

evidence.supports: Official August 2026 USGS version 2 source release and downloadable original archives.
Original 10 m bathymetry metadata identifies the published offshore depth range and CC0 terms.
Original CMECS metadata identifies substrate, geoform and biotic classifications and public-domain reuse terms.

limitations: Exact scan of 91,044,551 valid 10 m bathymetry cells found zero candidate cells in nominal 200 ft or 300 ft bands using the original source elevations. A chart-datum conversion has not been approved; shallow bottom-fishing targets must not be generated from this release.
The 373,920 CMECS polygons, including 47,342 bedrock polygons, are historical offshore habitat interpretations, not that many fishing spots or fish observations.
The source-wide rectangle includes unmeasured gaps. It is not a navigable outline or a regional coverage guarantee.
Deepwater research use still needs MPA, federal-area, hazard, route, species and present-condition checks.
